claim: maintenance.api_database_optimize closes the g-scoped DB connection, breaking later same-request queries
rationale: FALSE POSITIVE: get_db() (services/database.py:78) ALWAYS opens a fresh sqlite3 connection — it never returns the flask.g-cached connection (that is get_request_db()). api_database_optimize (routes/maintenance.py:166) runs VACUUM/ANALYZE on that dedicated fresh connection and closes only it; g.db is untouched. Verified 2026-06-05. The Lane 9 reviewer assumed get_db()==g.db, which is not the codebase's contract.

claim: bandit B608 (×92) "Possible SQL injection through string-based query construction" across routes/ and services/
rationale: False positive. Every f-string SQL interpolation in this codebase splices ONLY one of: (a) a column name validated through safe_column(field, allowlist) against a frozenset (e.g. routes/games.py:1036,1097,1125; routes/platform_import.py:89-92 checks platform_field against ('steam_app_id','xbox_title_id','psn_npwr_id')); (b) a static helper-built fragment (_owner_clause returns '1=0'/'1=1'/'{alias}.owner_id = ?' with a caller-literal alias; order_clause/order_sql come from fixed sort_map dicts; where_missing/where_empty/limit_clause are ternary literals); or (c) a placeholder join "','.join('?'*len(ids))". All actual values are bound via ? parameters. Matches the documented safe_column() invariant in CLAUDE.md and the project's existing .semgrep-excludes.txt exclusion of tainted-sql-string. bandit is flow-blind to the allowlist gate.

claim: bandit B201 "Flask app run with debug=True" at app.py:1843
rationale: False positive. app.py:1843 app.run(debug=True) is inside `if config.DEBUG_MODE:` (app.py:1837). DEBUG_MODE is os.environ RETRODB_DEBUG defaulting to "false" (config.py:82). Production runs Waitress (app.py:1851). debug=True is correct when the operator has explicitly opted into dev mode. bandit cannot see the env-gated conditional.

claim: bandit B104 "Possible binding to all interfaces" at config.py:80
rationale: False positive / intentional. SERVER_HOST defaults to "0.0.0.0" (config.py:80) because RetroDB is a LAN-only single-household app where viewers reach it from other devices on the home network; there is no port forwarding. Overridable via RETRODB_HOST env. Documented deployment threat model.

claim: bandit B310 (×3) "Audit url open for permitted schemes" at routes/scraper.py:322,363,394
rationale: False positive. All three urllib.request.urlopen calls use URLs built from hardcoded https:// string literals (api.thegamesdb.net, id.twitch.tv, api.rawg.io); only API keys are f-string-interpolated into the query string. The scheme is fixed https — no user-controlled scheme, no file:// reachable.

Not a typo — it is ScreenScraper's own French API endpoint path. Line 25 is `SYSTEMS_URL = f"{API_BASE}/systemesListe.php"`, sitting in a block of French endpoint names from the same vendor (jeuInfos.php, jeuRecherche.php, ssuserInfos.php, mediaSysteme.php). api.screenscraper.fr is a French service and spells the route `systemesListe.php`. "Correcting" the spelling would 404 every system-list request. Only occurrence in the tree. Applying this suggestion is a live defect, not a cleanup.

Neither is a misspelling. `excluder` is a deliberate agent noun — the sentence reads "references an `awk` excluder, run that excluder and pass the flags through"; "excluded" is ungrammatical there. `Writeable` is a table column header ("Writeable from UI?") and is a legitimate variant spelling of `Writable`; both are accepted English, there is one occurrence, and changing it is a drive-by edit on a spec with no defect behind it. Also noted: typos over the whole tree is unusable here — 4,157 raw findings, of which 3,948 come from non-English content (translations/*.po, per-locale help.<locale>.html) that an English corrector cannot read, and 68 more from the vendored static/js/vendor/chart.umd.min.js. Scope it to English-language source before reading its output.

claim: mypy (no project config): 118 errors in 51 files — none reproduces as a runtime defect
rationale: Verified the highest-signal ten against source; all are annotation gaps on a codebase that has never been type-checked (CLAUDE.md excludes mypy from the gates by design, and there is no [tool.mypy] section). 43 of 118 are import-untyped on third-party libs shipping no stubs. Specific dismissals: scripts/retrodb_launcher.py:72 `subprocess.CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE` is inside `if os.name == 'nt':` — mypy on Linux cannot narrow the platform guard; scraper/scraper_manager.py:30/:39 no-redef and None-to-Module are the deliberate, commented `try: import / except ImportError:` fallback idiom; tests/test_hltb_endpoint.py:53 `first.end_lineno + 1` is int|None only in the ast stubs, always set on a parsed ast.Expr; scraper/trophy_parser.py:80/:358 `tuple(v)` over a fixed 2-element list widens to tuple[int,...]; scraper/rom_tools.py:1158 `size /= 1024` on an int param formats identically at runtime; services/log_redactor.py:113 and services/launcher/local.py:80+ are inferred-`object` from unannotated containers. Real work, but…

claim: semgrep: 4 findings surviving .semgrep-excludes.txt — hardcoded TESTING config x2, hardcoded-password-default-argument, render-template-string
rationale: All four are in tests/ and all four are the test being a test. tests/test_auth_hardening.py:402 and tests/test_etag_and_gzip.py:23 set Flask TESTING — that is what a test client does. tests/test_auth_hashing.py:26 `_make_legacy_hash(password="legacy_password")` is a helper's default whose whole purpose is to describe the pre-v2.84.0 hash format in one place (its own docstring says so); the literal is not a credential and authenticates nothing. tests/test_security_headers.py:141 `render_template_string('{{ csp_nonce }}')` is a constant template with no interpolation and no user input — the test exists to assert the context processor and the response header emit the same nonce, so the template string IS the assertion. No injection surface in any of the four.
